title: Make the native build action configure fresh VIXEN checkouts
body: The queued documented command tools/vixen-native.sh --lane leafinstr-base --branch lane-landvx1-base build build vixen-ninja-release vixen_lookdev_capture failed before compilation because C:/vixen-native/leafinstr-base/build/ninja-release did not exist. Recovery used the same queued route with build all, which configured and built the target. The wrapper/build.bat contract should either configure automatically for a fresh-tree build action or fail with a clear diagnostic.
